abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify system behavior when rapidly switching between themes
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify system behavior when rapidly switching between themes
Module: Goodweather - Theme Switching Edge Case
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- - User is logged in and navigated to the Theme settings screen.
- - Application is running without any background activity issues.

Test Steps:
1. Click on the Theme option under General settings.
2. Rapidly click between the dark mode radio button and the default/light mode radio button multiple times without waiting for the 2-second delay.
3. Observe the application’s response after each theme switch.
4. Once finished, click on the back icon to return to the previous screen.

Expected Result:
- - Application correctly updates the UI theme according to the latest selected mode.
- - No unexpected crashes, visual glitches, or unresponsive UI states occur.
- - The theme remains consistent with the user's last selection after returning to the main screen.

Test Case Title: Attempt to search for a non-existent location
Module: GoodWeather - Location Search
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User has successfully launched the GoodWeather app and dismissed any initial alerts.
- - User is on the main screen with search functionality available.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the "Search" button.
2. Wait for the "Search location" input field to appear.
3. Enter an invalid or non-existent location name (for example, "AtlantisXYZ") in the search location field.
4. Wait for search results to populate.

Expected Result:

- - No results or an explicit "Location not found" message is displayed when searching for a non-existent place.
- - The "IN" or any valid option does not appear for the invalid location.
- - User remains on the search screen and is able to try another search.

Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - User has a valid Facebook account with a known username and password
- - User is logged out of Facebook
- - Supported browser is available and functional

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to facebook.com in the browser.
2. Enter the valid username in the email or phone input field.

Expected Result:

- - No error messages are displayed.
- - User’s profile picture or name is visible on the page header.

- Clicking the link opens the size guide without errors.
- Size guide contains clear and comprehensive measurement and size selection instructions.
- User can switch between different sizing options within the guide.
- Instructions update accordingly when changing between sizing options.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Successful New Customer Sign-Up Process
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Successful New Customer Sign-Up Process
Module: Customer Registration / Sign-Up
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - The application is installed and accessible.
- - User is not logged into any account.

Test Steps:
1. Launch the application.
2. Wait for the application home screen to become visible.
3. Tap on the Sign-Up button.
4. Wait until the Sign-Up screen is displayed.
5. Enter "John" in the First Name field.
6. Enter "John.doe@gamil.com" in the Email Address field.
7. Enter "John@123" in the Password field.
8. Enter "John@123" in the Confirm Password field.
9. Tap on the Sign-Up button.
10. Wait for the application to process the registration.

Expected Result:
- - The Sign-Up screen is displayed with all required registration fields.
- - Entered values in all fields are accepted (First Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password).
- - Password and Confirm Password fields match.
- - A new customer account is created successfully.
- - The application navigates to the next appropriate screen (e.g., user dashboard or welcome page).

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Sign-Up Fails with Mismatched Password and Confirm Password
Module: Customer Registration / Sign-Up
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - The application is installed and accessible.
- - User is not logged into any account.

Test Steps:
1. Launch the application.
2. Wait for the application home screen to become visible.
3. Tap on the Sign-Up button.
4. Wait until the Sign-Up screen is displayed.
5. Enter "John" in the First Name field.
6. Enter "John.doe@gamil.com" in the Email Address field.
7. Enter "John@123" in the Password field.
8. Enter "John@456" in the Confirm Password field (different value).
9. Tap on the Sign-Up button.

Expected Result:
- - The Sign-Up process does not proceed.
- - An appropriate error message is displayed indicating that the Password and Confirm Password fields do not match.
- - The user remains on the Sign-Up screen with all previously entered data retained (except for security reasons if passwords need to be re-entered).
- - No customer account is created.
